incidents.name: WUSD GLOVE wrap-reward Sybil farm
incidents.notes: Not a code defect: WUSD.wrap()'s _englove() reward mints GLOVE to any address whose current GLOVE balance is below _MAX_GLOVE, an incentive with no identity binding, so a fleet of fresh addresses each qualified for a full mint and the GLOVE was sold into the Uniswap V3 GLO pools.

sources.ref: onchain review: WUSD 0x068E3563b1c19590F822c0e13445c4FA1b9EEFa5 created 2023-01-22 by 0x7f08290e69c548849931877f14f98586025d3716, unrelated to attack sender; no EIP-1967 upgrade events; GLOVE reward token 0x70c5f366db60a2a0c59c4c24754803ee47ed7284
